text:
irene: Starting onboarding for nightingale-lite int8-ptq. Canary shows funcall/json parse failures correlated with high kvcache hit rate + large batch windows. Sample failure: raw stream contains duplicated suffix and a broken array boundary.
sam: paste sample plz
irene:
```
RESP RAW: "{\"action\":\"call_tool\",\"payload\":{\"name\":\"get_profile\",\"args\":{\"user\":\"u123\"},\"meta\":[1,2,3}\
}\
```
kevin: Looks like closing bracket swapped from ] to } and then extra closing brace. Could be tokenization boundary misalign + kv-prefix replay. Which runtime + tokenizer?
irene: runtime 2.14.2, tokenizer 0.9.4, model build 2026-03-20 int8-ptq. Canary cmd: `./canary --model nightingale-lite --quant int8 --batch 32 --kvcache=true --kv_batch=16`.
ci-bot: canary summary: 3 runs, avg parse_fail 11.2%, peak 15.3%.
maria: Notes: pattern only when kv_batch>10 + kvcache true. If either off, fail rate ~0.6%.
sam: Proposed fixes: 1) runtime chunk alignment heuristic (prefer cut after tokens like `]`,`}`, `
`). 2) small decoding-time sanitizer that detects mismatch of brackets and attempts to repair by swapping last brace if counts unequal. 3) client-side tolerant parser release.
kevin: runtime change behind feature flag `prefer_json_boundary=true` seems safest low-latency option. We'll need unit tests to show no perf regression.
maria: Also run structured-output compliance harness across: schema_pass_rate, funcall_success, retry_win_rate, and semantic correctness (tool returned expected fields). Baseline against raven-v2q int8 and heron-lite int4.
irene: Action list: sam: client parser PR and small repair fn; kevin: runtime flag PR + perf microbench; maria: run 10k sample compliance harness and collect split by kv_batch, batch_size, kvcache; ci-bot: queue canary with prefer_json_boundary=true.
ci-bot: queued: nightingale-lite int8, batch=32, kv_batch=16, kvcache=true, prefer_json_boundary=true. ETA 20m.
sam: If runtime flag reduces failures to <1% we can roll it to prod quickly, otherwise combine runtime + client repair.
kevin: I'll add `chunk_boundary_hint` in frame metadata to help postmortem.
maria: Remember to keep seeds fixed for diffs. seed=2026-03-20. Reconvene after results.
